name: gustline.places.search
description: Search the seeded gazetteer by name. No geocoding service.

name: gustline.places.get
description: Get one place with its forecast zone, air area, station and monitor.

name: gustline.saved_places.list
description: List the account's saved places and their labels.

name: gustline.settings.get
description: Read units, the person's own time zone and the default saved place.

name: gustline.forecast.get
description: Forecast periods for a place from the issuance current at the run's virtual time, rendered in the place's local time.

name: gustline.forecast.history
description: List weather or air-quality issuances for a place, newest first, with their supersession status.

name: gustline.observations.get
description: Observations from the place's station between two times, with corrections and earlier values.

name: gustline.astro.get
description: Sunrise, sunset and civil twilight for a place and local date (NOAA solar algorithm).

name: gustline.air.current
description: Current AQI at a place from its monitor: per-pollutant values, averaging basis (hourly PM concentration, not EPA NowCast; 8-hour O3), category and staleness.

name: gustline.air.forecast
description: Daily AQI category forecast for a place from the current air-quality issuance.

name: gustline.alerts.list
description: Official alerts affecting a place, with status derived at the run's virtual time.

name: gustline.alerts.get
description: One alert with its full version chain, or one version.

name: gustline.rules.list
description: List personal alert rules.

name: gustline.rules.get
description: One rule with its revision history.

name: gustline.notifications.list
description: Notifications with their delivery status derived at the run's virtual time.

name: gustline.saved_places.add
description: Save a place under the person's own label.

name: gustline.saved_places.rename
description: Change a saved place's label.

name: gustline.saved_places.remove
description: Remove a saved place that no rule refers to.

name: gustline.settings.update
description: Change units, the person's time zone or the default saved place.

name: gustline.rules.create
description: Create a personal alert rule.

name: gustline.rules.update
description: Change fields of a rule; the rule keeps a revision history.

name: gustline.rules.pause
description: Pause a rule; it is not evaluated while paused.

name: gustline.rules.resume
description: Resume a paused rule from the next event, with no retroactive notification.

name: gustline.rules.delete
description: Delete a rule. Notifications already sent are kept; any still held by quiet hours or waiting for delivery are withdrawn.

name: gustline.notifications.acknowledge
description: Mark a notification as read.
